about_the_game:
Command your troops amidst the flames of war in the Three Kingdoms era! Dominate the land and forge a new legend! This is an idle/incremental game set against the backdrop of the Three Kingdoms. Collect legendary heroes and command them in battle to restore the glory of the Han Dynasty!

Game Features:

  • An idle/incremental game set in the Three Kingdoms period – fun and easy to play!

Game Systems:

  • Hero System: Recruit legendary heroes like the Five Tiger Generals, Five Elite Generals, Sleeping Dragon and Fledgling Phoenix (Zhuge Liang & Pang Tong), and more! Lead these fierce Three Kingdoms warriors to unify the realm!

  • Character System: Significantly boost your base attributes by equipping gear, undergoing Reincarnation, and acquiring Divine Equipment.

  • Forging System: Comprehensively enhance your equipment through:

    • Enhancement System

    • Gem System

    • Star Upgrade System

    • Soul Enchantment System

    • (Greatly increase your combat power!)

  • Kingdom System: Choose an allegiance to Wei, Shu, or Wu. Increase Kingdom Skills and purchase rare items from the Kingdom Shop by donating and completing Kingdom Quests.

Gameplay:

  • Daily Activities: Participate in multiple daily activities to earn abundant rare items and essential daily resources.

  • Cross-Server Events: Compete against players from different servers in the same event, experiencing the fierce struggle to dominate the Central Plains!

  • BOSS Battles: Face various challenges:

    • Personal BOSSes

    • Open-World BOSSes fought by all players

    • Extremely Difficult BOSS Battlefields

    • (Acquire top-tier equipment here!)

  • Arena Gameplay: Engage in Solo PvP and Team-based PvP combat.
